name: u068-fresh-core-red
purpose: ACTUAL NEW ATTEMPT: unchanged retained core BDD assertions against an explicitly naive noncompliant HTTP subject before any reused implementation is installed in this attempt; original chronology remains uncertified

notOk: every decision of a lease is appended in order with the figures before and after, the expiry included
an owner sees only its own records without the sequence, the subject or any pool figure, and never a record of the other lease
the operator sees every record with its sequence, subject, role and pool figures, and its own reads are audited
every ring is bounded and a flood by one identity never evicts the records of another
no record holds a token, an idempotency key or a client claim
a visitor and an anonymous client have no audit view and the operator has no conductor audit
a batch with an own reserve and an over-limit reserve is refused whole with the index and the code, and nothing was reserved
a batch that exceeds the pool with its second operation is refused whole and the first is not kept
a batch that releases a foreign or an absent reservation is refused whole with the same bytes and changes nothing
inside a batch the same key with the same body replays and with another body is a conflict that refuses the whole batch
a malformed batch is refused: size, shape, unknown operations and claims
two batches racing for the last two units: one is applied whole and the other refused whole
a batch is refused for every other identity and a released reservation inside it replays
a number that is not a plain integer inside the bounds is refused: syntax errors and wrong values each with a typed code
a string or number in the place of the tier, and a tier outside the price table, are refused
a malformed or hostile body is a typed refusal that closes the connection and reserves nothing
the media type, the size and a body where none belongs are refused
no variant of an own id reaches the reservation: trailing characters, encodings, case, look-alikes and long ids are typed refusals
a retry with the same key and the same body returns the same reservation and reserves nothing more
the same key with another body is a typed conflict that closes the connection and changes nothing
keys are scoped per lease: another lease with the same key is independent and nothing tells it that the key was used
the identical key and body of another lease never replays the reservation of the first
a retry after a release or an expiry answers the same reservation and reserves nothing
a key of another shape or a missing key is refused and reserves nothing
a foreign reservation, an absent one and a malformed id answer the same bytes, for a read and for a release
a foreign release has no effect on the reservation, the pool or the books
lists and counts show only the own reservations, in creation order
the allowance is the own caps and holdings: it never moves with the activity of the other lease and shows no pool headroom
the pool headroom and the books of every lease belong to the operator alone
every refusal of the identity and of the bounds closes the connection
a second release answers the same reservation, says replayed and returns nothing twice
expiry returns the units at the deadline of the injected clock and not a millisecond before
an expired reservation cannot be released again, reused or spent twice, and its capacity can be reserved again
the reservations of the other lease keep their units, spend, state and deadline across a release and an expiry
each reservation expires at its own deadline
the history of a lease is bounded: the oldest ended reservation goes first and its id becomes absent
many connections racing for the last unit: exactly one wins and every loser has a typed refusal and no effect
a lease cap is never over-admitted by simultaneous requests of one lease
a reserve racing an expiry sees the capacity back at the deadline
two leases racing one pool: exactly one wins and neither consumes the other reservation
the same key sent by many connections at once reserves once and every answer is the same reservation
the same key with different bodies sent at once: one body wins and the others are a typed conflict
RESERVATION_LIMIT_REACHED: a typed refusal that names the bound, closes the connection and changes nothing
LEASE_SPEND_CAP_EXCEEDED: a typed refusal that names the bound, closes the connection and changes nothing
CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: a typed refusal that names the bound, closes the connection and changes nothing
SPEND_EXCEEDED: a typed refusal that names the bound, closes the connection and changes nothing
the bounds are decided in a fixed order and the lease own bounds come first
over its own cap a caller gets the lease code even where the pool would refuse too
the pool capacity is decided before the pool spend
a reservation that fits exactly is admitted and the next unit is refused
a spend that fits the ceiling exactly is admitted and one more unit of cost is refused
